notes.title: THE FUTURE OF SAMUEL (+ an interesting discovery)
notes.content:
So, I'mma start this off by saying that this so-called discovery was that the game ACTUALLY DOES run on windows 11! And it did the ENTIRE TIME. For some reason, it just didn't like my new computer at first for some reason (who the hell knows), but it's FINE NOW apparently.

This game still will not be receiving updates however, as I still don't actually have the source files for the game, and I don't give enough of a damn to find a way to recover them in some way. 

So, what's the future of our favorite mutant shapeshifting pile of white sludge?

An RPG.

Samuel's RPG.

notes.title: The Future of the Adventures of Samuel: the Worst Game Ever Made.
notes.content:
Due to a catastrophe leading to all of my computer's files being deleted, I have lost all of the files for the Adventures of Samuel. I didn't have it backed up, either. This means that this game will never receive updates. I was planning to go back and update the game to make a lot of the levels a lot more... possible. However, that cannot happen.

In this event, I have also had to bear the curse of Windows 11 (It's terrible). I have discovered the game cannot run on it. Sorry to anyone who has purchased the game on Windows 11 and discovered this. I can't even play my own game. Wonderful.

Is this the end for me? No. I plan to move on, and make actually good games, instead of making more abhorrent garbage like this. Yet again, I might make a sequel to this game. I had a lot of ideas that I never actually implemented. Emphasis on "might" though.
